Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: Misread “home ground of South Melbourne” on Wikipedia as indicating the suburb, and concluded the venue was in South Melbourne. In reality, Lake Oval is located in the suburb of Albert Park. This misinterpretation led to the wrong suburb being selected despite earlier evidence pointing to Albert Park.
